prompt: Painted in matte gouache for a printed book plate, flat shapes and soft edges, limited desaturated palette, drawn rather than rendered, figures small against architecture and sky, plain unmarked surfaces and bare stone, generous empty margin at the frame edge. a boy alone on the parapet of a black stone fortress, looking down at a burning quarter of the city below. a twelve-year-old noble boy, dark hair cut short, fine but travel-worn tunic, thin shoulders, standing very straight because he has decided to. a crowded coastal imperial city of black stone and tile roofs climbing from a harbour, a round fortress on an island offshore. three separate fires in one district, the rest of the city untouched and going about its evening. siege light, smoke columns, distant fire glow, figures small against ruined walls. palette of ash, soot brown and rust orange. wide establishing shot, deep space, low horizon.
